papers.title: Learnability of Linear Port-Hamiltonian Systems
verified_assumptions: Formal normal-form model in Sec2.2 Eq5-7 is linear, SISO, R=0, canonical symplectic J and unknown SPD Q; theta includes Q and B.
Input-output learning is considered; state-space isomorphisms with appropriate initializations can preserve the same input-output map.
Canonical class requires controllability and observability; unique-representation statement is within its defined equivalence class and up to initializations.
papers.implication: Unknown-Hamiltonian learning and coordinate-equivalence-aware parameter reduction already exist. The paper is not a general dissipative nonlinear MIMO physical-topology identification theorem.

papers.title: Port-Hamiltonian Dynamic Mode Decomposition
verified_assumptions: A quadratic energy functional is supplied.
Input, state and output measurements are used to identify a passive continuous-time linear realization.
The fitting method enforces the supplied energy dissipation inequality.
papers.implication: This is relevant structure-preserving operator identification; its stated input-state-output/known-energy setting differs from unknown-storage partial-observation identification.
